_comment: OPTIONAL provider-boundary training footprints, per research/batch3/01 §4. Core factors NEVER include these (SCI-for-AI: training is a separate provider metric); they feed only the supplementary incl_training column, amortized over lifetime_output_tokens_T (trillions, [P5,P50,P95], label speculation for everyone — nobody discloses volumes). Models absent here simply get no incl_training column (honest absence, no fabrication).

llama_3_3_70b.label: estimate
llama_3_3_70b.source: Llama 3.1 family: 11,390 t location-based / 39.3M H100-hrs disclosed (HF card, arXiv:2204.05149 methodology); 70B-class share estimated

llama_4_maverick.label: speculation
llama_4_maverick.source: no per-model disclosure found for Llama 4; scaled from Llama 3.1 405B (8,930 t / 30.84M hrs) by MoE training economics

deepseek_4_pro.label: speculation
deepseek_4_pro.source: V3 anchor: 2.788M H800-hrs disclosed (arXiv:2412.19437) ~600-1000 t on CN grid; V4 assumed 1.5-3x

glm_5_2.label: speculation
glm_5_2.source: 28.5T pretraining tokens disclosed; Ascend fleet efficiency ~2x worse than H100 (batch2/02); CN grid ~555 g/kWh

kimi_k2_6.label: speculation
kimi_k2_6.source: 1T-total MoE, INT4 QAT; no disclosure; bracketed between DeepSeek-V3 and GLM-5 estimates

mistral_large_2.label: derived
mistral_large_2.source: 85.5% of disclosed 20.4 kt lifecycle = training+infra (Mistral LCA); lifetime volume speculation for an 18-month window

_excluded_note: claude_*, gpt_*, gemini_*: no disclosed or credibly estimable training footprint as of 2026-07-24 -> no incl_training column. Revisit if EU AI Act Annex XI disclosures (training energy, due for legacy models Aug 2027) surface data.
